chunks: Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah and ‘Abdallah ibn Ja‘far, both together, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, who said:

Ali ibn Musa عليه السلام passed away when he was forty-nine years and some months old, in the year two hundred and two. He lived after Musa ibn Ja‘far عليه السلام for twenty years, minus two or three months.

key_terms.بَعْدَ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ: after Musa ibn Ja‘far عليه السلام
key_terms.عَامِ اثْنَيْنِ وَمِائَتَيْنِ: the year two hundred and two
key_terms.عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُوسَى: Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Rida عليه السلام
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; a reverential expression for death

ai.seo_question: How old was Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Rida عليه السلام when he passed away, and how long did he live after Musa ibn Ja‘far عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report gives a brief biographical notice about Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Rida عليه السلام, stating his age at the time of his passing and the year in which it occurred. It also notes the length of time he lived after Musa ibn Ja‘far عليه السلام, preserving a chronological detail of the Imam’s life.

en.sarwar: 11. Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah and ‘Abdallah ibn Ja‘far all have narrated from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother Ali ibn Mahziyar from al-Hassan al-Husayn ibn Sa‘idfm Muhammad ibn Sinan who has said the following.
“Ali ibn Musa (a.s.) died at the age of forty nine and few months in the year two hundred and two AH. He lived for nineteen years and two or three month after the death of Musa ibn Ja‘far (a.s.).”
